quizName:
Sign Test
									  					
									  														  					Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that two lanes of traffic are about to combine into one lane.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: You should slow down and move to the right lane.
Stay in the right lane if you are driving slower than other traffic.
Slower traffic must exit on the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay in the right lane if you are driving slower than other traffic.
questions.explanation: White rectangular signs show rules you must follow. This sign means slower drivers should use the right lane to keep the left lane open for passing and faster traffic.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Be ready to merge with traffic entering your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to merge with traffic entering your lane.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that traffic will merge into your lane from the right. Be prepared to let them merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you that pedestrians may cross ahead. You must stop and wait until pedestrians are completely out of the crosswalk.

questions.question: What do signs with orange backgrounds mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs are used only for construction and maintenance warnings.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A five-sided yellow or yellow-green sign warns you about a school zone or school crossing.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on the road.
There is a series of curves ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions immediately ahead. This sign warns of an upcoming winding road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left. It is unsafe and illegal to make a left turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does an orange and red triangular sign on a vehicle always mean?
questions.explanation: Slow-moving vehicles like farm tractors, road maintenance vehicles, and horse-drawn carts display an orange and red triangle on the back.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you which direction you must drive. You must follow the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign always means a railroad crossing is coming. Be prepared to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can travel in either direction in this lane.
You are approaching a divided highway.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic flows in both directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You might see it where oncoming traffic is heavy.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that an intersection is coming. Slow down and be ready for traffic or turns.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way road or exit. If you see this sign, traffic is coming toward you. Turn around.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you must stop and:

options.text: Check only the direction you plan to go, then proceed.
Let all vehicles that arrive before or after you go first.
Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, come to a full stop. Look left, right, and ahead for traffic before you go.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you of a steep hill. Slow down to avoid crashes and brake damage.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a crosswalk. Watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red and white triangle sign means you must yield. Let other traffic go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars on the right move first.
Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.
questions.explanation: When you see this sign, you must yield the right-of-way. Slow down and let vehicles and pedestrians cross before you go. Stop if you need to.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Last turn before a toll road.

questions.explanation: Orange signs warn drivers about work zones. Stay alert and be ready for changing driving conditions. This sign tells you a flagger is ahead. You must follow the flagger's directions.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left then right.
The road ahead curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right then left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road will curve right, then curve left. Slow down to safely navigate the curves.

questions.question: When you approach an octagonal sign, you must:
questions.explanation: An octagonal (eight-sided) sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop, check for traffic and pedestrians, and go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You should stop for other traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road and you should allow additional space for drivers to merge safely into the flow of traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road and you should keep right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is entering from another road and you should allow additional space for drivers to merge safely into the flow of traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic will merge into your lane. Check your mirrors and side. Move to another lane if possible to give merging drivers space.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a divided highway begins ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round yellow sign warns you of a railroad crossing ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell drivers what traffic laws they must follow. This sign means you cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers about hazards ahead. Round signs are only used to warn about railroad crossings.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this intersection. Turning right here is unsafe and against the law.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are not allowed to travel in this direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are not allowed to travel in this direction.
questions.explanation: Red signs tell drivers what is prohibited. If you see this sign, you are going the wrong way. Turn around immediately.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you should:

options.text: Prepare to stop at a railroad crossing ahead.
Always stop at the railroad crossing ahead.
Stop and wait for a signal before crossing the tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Prepare to stop at a railroad crossing ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is coming. Slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop. Wait for any trains to pass before continuing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a steep hill or downgrade coming up. The hill may be long, steep, or have sharp curves.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign tells you that a divided highway is starting. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This triangular yellow sign with black letters means no passing. You will see it on the left side of a two-lane road where passing is not allowed.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and let trains pass first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let trains pass first.
questions.explanation: This round sign warns you of a railroad crossing. It is posted a few hundred feet before the tracks. Slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop for trains.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This pentagonal sign means you are in or near a school zone. Watch for children and obey the speed limit.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell drivers to watch for bicycles crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Left turns are not allowed here.
A left turn can be made only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Left turns are not allowed here.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign prohibits left turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for vehicles entering from the side.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you to keep right of an island or barrier. The road ahead is divided.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: A curve in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A curve in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions just ahead. This sign warns of an upcoming right curve.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: Be ready to stop if the light is flashing.

questions.explanation: A yellow sign with a traffic signal symbol means a traffic signal is coming. Get ready to respond to the upcoming signal.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: This orange warning sign tells drivers that roadwork is coming. Stay alert for temporary traffic signs in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a stop sign is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that there is a pedestrian crosswalk.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means that U-turns are prohibited in this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a yield sign is coming. Start slowing down when you see this warning.

questions.question: What is this bicyclist signaling?
questions.explanation: Bicycles do not have turn signals. Bicyclists use hand and arm signals instead. A left arm straight out means the bicyclist is turning left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed on slow-moving vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions ahead. This sign warns that another road crosses the highway ahead.

questions.question: What is this symbol used for?
questions.explanation: An orange reflective triangle on the back of a vehicle means it travels slowly. You may see this on construction equipment, farm vehicles, or horse-drawn wagons. It looks like a solid orange triangle during the day and a hollow red triangle at night.

questions.question: What is the correct order of traffic lights from top to bottom?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions ahead. This sign warns that traffic signals are at an intersection ahead.

questions.question: What does an orange sign like this mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs show construction areas. Drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and yield to traffic on the main road when merging.
Always come to a complete stop.
Activate your turn signal and proceed into traffic at normal speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield to traffic on the main road when merging.
questions.explanation: A three-sided yield sign means you must wait for vehicles on the other road to pass before you go. You do not need to stop if no other vehicles are coming, but always slow down and enter carefully.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to upcoming hazards and are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that traffic may merge into your lane from the right.

questions.question: What does a diamond-shaped sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn drivers of hazards ahead. They are usually yellow or orange.

questions.question: If you want to turn left at an intersection with this signal, what should you do?

options.text: Turn as long as you yield to other drivers.
Come to a full stop and proceed when it is safe.
Come to a full stop and stay stopped while the red arrow is lit.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and stay stopped while the red arrow is lit.
questions.explanation: A red left arrow means you must stop before the intersection. Do not turn. Stay stopped until the red arrow turns off.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign tells you that people may be crossing the road. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that another road crosses ahead.

questions.question: What does this yellow warning sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching a school or school crosswalk.
Slow down, drive with caution, and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign is placed near schools to warn drivers. You should slow down, be careful, and watch for children.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this red and white sign?

options.text: Stop and check for traffic from both directions before going.
Let other traffic go first before you enter or cross the road.
Keep your speed steady and check all directions for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let other traffic go first before you enter or cross the road.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and be ready to stop if needed. You do not have the right-of-way. Let vehicles, bicycles, or pedestrians pass before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You may turn right at a red light if you are careful.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means you cannot do that action. This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has many curves.
There is a sharp curve in the road ahead.
The road ahead may be slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead may be slippery.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road may be slippery when wet. Drive slowly and carefully.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this intersection. You cannot turn around to go the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for people with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign is posted where you are not allowed to enter. You may see it on one-way streets or if you try to enter an expressway ramp in the wrong direction.

questions.question: This shape and color is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: A triangle pointing down is a yield sign. Slow down to a safe speed and stop if needed. Stop at a marked line if one exists.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that another road crosses ahead. Be prepared for other traffic entering from the side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn drivers about hazards. Orange warning signs show construction areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You cannot turn on a red light.

questions.correctAnswerText: You cannot turn on a red light.
questions.explanation: This is a traffic law sign. It tells drivers that turning right or left on a red light is not allowed at this intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a divided highway begins ahead. Stay to the right of the median divider.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you about the road ahead?

options.text: It turns sharply right, then left.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road will curve right, then curve left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic is merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions coming up. This sign tells you to prepare for traffic entering from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a winding road is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign means you must stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a traffic law sign. Where this sign is posted, you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What information do blue traffic signs provide?

options.text: Distance and directions to specific places.

questions.explanation: Blue signs show driver services. They tell you about rest areas, food, gas, hospitals, and other services nearby.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the divided highway is ending. Be ready to change lanes or adjust your position.

questions.question: When you see a flashing red traffic light, you should:

options.text: You are driving in the wrong direction.
Treat it like a stop sign.
You must wait for it to turn green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Treat it like a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means stop. Come to a complete stop at the stop line or before the crosswalk. Let all other traffic and pedestrians go first.

questions.question: When you see this yellow sign, you should:

options.text: Stop at the crosswalk until a crossing guard tells you to go.
Be ready to stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to stop if children are in the crosswalk.
questions.explanation: This five-sided sign means you are near a school. Watch carefully and stop if you see children crossing.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that you are leaving a divided road and entering a highway where traffic moves in both directions.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: The speed limit changes to 35 mph after the curve.
Drive at least 35 mph through the curve.
Slow down to 35 mph or less for the curve ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down to 35 mph or less for the curve ahead.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs tell you about road conditions ahead. The number on this sign shows the safe speed for the curve. Slow down to 35 mph or less.

questions.question: This white sign means you:

options.text: Can only turn left on a green arrow.
Can turn left on a green light if it is safe.
Must wait for a solid green light before turning left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Can turn left on a green light if it is safe.
questions.explanation: A "yield" sign means slow down and let others go first. After yielding to traffic and pedestrians, you may turn left on the green light.

questions.question: A flashing yellow light at an intersection means you should:

options.text: Stop as quickly as you can.
Stop and wait until the intersection is clear.

questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down and look both ways. You do not have to stop completely.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: A sharp right turn is ahead.
A road joins from the right.
The road turns sharp right, then sharp left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharp right, then sharp left.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to road conditions. This sign warns that the road ahead curves sharply right and then sharply left.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to road conditions. This sign warns that your road ends at an intersection ahead. Slow down and prepare to stop before turning.

questions.question: This sign warns drivers that:

options.text: The right lane is ending. Move to the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending. Move to the left lane.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to road conditions ahead. This sign tells you that one lane is ending and you need to move to the left.

questions.question: When displayed on the back of a vehicle, this sign indicates:

options.text: The vehicle is pulled by an animal.
The vehicle travels at 25 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle travels at 25 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: Slow-moving vehicles like bicycles, horse-drawn wagons, or farm equipment display this sign. It warns other drivers that the vehicle will travel at 25 mph or slower.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: Wet roads are slippery and dangerous. This sign warns you about dangerous conditions. Slow down when you see wet pavement because it takes longer to stop.

questions.question: If you see a sign over your lane with an arrow and the word "only" below it, you should:

options.text: Go in the direction of the arrow.
Look for a destination sign to follow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Go in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a lane control sign. It tells you that you must move in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Pentagonal signs warn you that you are near a school zone or school crossing. Be alert and ready to stop when you see these signs.

questions.question: What does this speed limit sign mean?

options.text: You must travel through the intersection at this speed.
The highest safe speed under good conditions is 55 mph.
You cannot drive slower than this speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest safe speed under good conditions is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the maximum speed allowed on this road. You can drive slower if needed, but never faster. You must obey this speed limit.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is one-way only.
There is a detour to the right.
The road ahead makes a sharp turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead makes a sharp turn.
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn you of road conditions ahead. This sign tells you to slow down because the road changes direction sharply.

questions.question: This white sign means you should not pass other vehicles:

options.text: Until after you pass the sign.
Unless it seems safe to do so.

questions.explanation: White rectangular signs show rules you must follow. This sign means you cannot pass other vehicles under any circumstances.

questions.question: What does a stop sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if other cars are near.
Come to a full stop, then go when it is safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and look both ways. Only proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Parking reserved for people with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking reserved for people with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disability license plates or disability parking permits.

questions.question: What does this low clearance sign tell you?

options.text: The height from the road to the bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal vehicle height in this state.
The maximum vehicle width allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The height from the road to the bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the height from the road surface to the bottom of a bridge or overpass. Check your vehicle's height before entering.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: A construction worker with a flag is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A construction worker with a flag is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flagger is ahead. Always follow the flagger's directions. Flaggers wear bright clothing and use flags and paddles to direct traffic safely through construction zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road changes direction or gets narrower.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road changes direction or gets narrower.
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the road is about to change direction or become narrower. You may see these signs on sharp curves or near narrow bridges.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downgrade is coming. Check your brakes before going down.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells drivers that the right lane is ending. Get ready for traffic that may merge into your lane.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic from another lane may merge into your lane.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: The railroad crossing is controlled. Drive at your normal speed.
Look and listen. Be ready to stop if needed.
Stop at the railroad tracks and wait for a signal before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look and listen. Be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: When you approach a railroad crossing, look and listen. Slow down and be ready to stop. Wait for any trains to pass before you cross.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you that you are leaving a one-way highway. You will soon drive on a road with traffic going both directions.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: A downward-pointing triangle sign is always a yield sign. When you see it, be ready to slow down or stop.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: There is a sharp turn to the right.
A right turn is permitted on a green arrow only.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a sharp turn to the right.
questions.explanation: Some warning signs are bright yellow-green. These signs warn you about upcoming road conditions, including curves and sharp turns.
